name: stop_goal
description: Cancel the active find_object goal and its current search, navigation, tracking, or approach step.

name: stop_navigation
description: Cancel an active navigate_action during vision pose selection or Nav2 movement.

name: stop_follow
description: Stop the active follow_action, including its current search, tracking, or approach step.

name: stop_tracking
description: Stop passive tracking started by watch_target. Use this when the robot should stop watching even if no other action follows.
